title: Niko's Broken Tools
description: This project adds 3 dynamic visual breaking stages for your main tools and swords using 100% pure vanilla power. No mods or OptiFine required!
body:
One day, a player was mining deep underground, sweating and crying because their diamond pickaxe was about to snap. They looked at their hotbar and thought:
 **"Dude, Minecraft is boring! Why do swords and tools look perfectly shiny and brand new until the exact microsecond they explode into trash? I wish I could actually SEE them breaking!"**  
                 
Suddenly, the cave started shaking. A giant Herobrine-like figure appeared from the lava and said: "Thy wish is granted, my visual learner." The figure vanished, and all the tools in the world received this pack.
_______________________________________________________________________________________________
##    Welcome to Niko's Broken Tools!
 **This 100% vanilla resource pack completely changes how you look at your gear by adding 3 dynamic breaking stages (at 25%, 50%, and 75% durability loss) strictly for your Swords, Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, and Hoes! No OptiFine or CIT mods required—just pure JSON magic!**

-  **And why would i download your pack?**
-  Cause my pack adds special details to every material your tool is made of!
  For example, if your tool is made out of wood, it has leaves on it! If your tool is made out of Stone, it is connected by ropes! If your tool is made out of iron,it will eventually be covered by rust! I dont really know what to add to netherite tools and golden tools yet tho... But if your tool is made out of Diamond it will have premium leather-wrapped-handle!

_________________________________________________________________________________________________

This pack is now Discontinued due to burnout, but thanks for downloading my pack!
